answer_1.quote: With the development of benchmark datasets, such as WikiSQL  and Spider , many Text-to-SQL models have been proposed to map natural language utterances to executable SQL queries.

answer_2.quote: We define a new Bias Score to quantitatively measure social biases in generated SQLs. If at least one demographic dimension appears in the generated SQL without any explicit references in database queries, we view this SQL as a biased one.
